_readme: Copy to config.json and fill in. Every path is relative to this file's folder. Every number marked EXAMPLE was measured on one specific recording and is wrong for yours: measure your own tape (see README.md, stage 1). Keys starting with _ are comments.
_transcript: Scribe-shaped word JSON: {"words": [{"text", "start", "end", "type": "word", "speaker_id"}]}. Produce it with .claude/skills/shorts-editor/scripts/transcribe.py --keyterms-file keyterms.txt
_fonts_dir: Put the caption font file (and a display font for the opener) here. Not shipped: use fonts you hold a licence for.
_video_codec_args: On a Mac you can swap in ["-c:v", "h264_videotoolbox", "-b:v", "9M"] for a much faster render.
_silence: The threshold is a property of the room. If silencedetect finds nothing, the room is noisy: try -35 or -30. Never drop a clean tape toward -30.

layouts._note: EXAMPLE: deck on screen, hand-off measured TO THE FRAME
EXAMPLE: 7 people in the room, 3x3 gallery

share._note: EXAMPLE crops as [w, h, x, y] on the source recording. The deck crop sits BELOW the browser bar so tab titles and file paths never reach the cut. The face goes top left, the deck shifts right.

g32._note: EXAMPLE 3x2 gallery. keep = [row, col] tiles of the presenters, put back sharp. Every other tile is soft-blurred and every name strip hard-blurred. Check the presenters' tile positions every 5 s before a render: galleries reflow.

_grid_title: Optional text drawn on the gallery background (needs a display font in fonts_dir). Leave empty for a plain background.
_blur: Soft enough that a person stays a person (radius 16 x 3 measured right; 40 was a smear). boxblur caps silently: luma_radius <= 24, chroma_radius <= half the region's chroma height (label_h / 4 for 4:2:0). build.py validates both before rendering.

captions._note: Set font and highlight from content/brand.md ({BRAND_FONT_CAPTION}, {BRAND_ACCENT}). calib: libass draws some fonts smaller than PIL measures; 0.63 was measured for one bold sans. y_base must keep the block below every speaker's mouth on every layout.

_probe_times: One raw second per layout. `build.py probe` renders each through the shipping segment path and saves its first frame.

cuts._note: EXAMPLE keep ranges in raw seconds. A condensed cut is pure subtraction in the tape's own order: never re-sequence.

_overrides: For these raw ranges, use a pre-rendered frame-size video (the animated opener from opener.py) instead of the layout. Its timeline is the ranges concatenated. Remove this block until the opener exists.
_deck_stills: In that range the deck slot shows a real frame of the finished slide, so a card clicked late lands as the words do. Remove until the PNG exists.
chapters: What you will be able to answer
_chapters: Raw seconds to title. A chapter lands on the first kept frame at or after its time (within 30 s) and is written on the DELIVERED (sped) timeline.

handover.title: {RECORDING_NAME}: the cuts
handover.rulings: {One line: the host's rulings this build follows, in their words.}
left_out: {what you left out on purpose, so they can subtract in one word}
decisions: {each open choice, written as a question a stranger could act on}
next_steps: Watch the condensed cut and send what comes out
